candidate.title: Drop-ChIP / scChIP-seq
candidate.scope: The middle row of the assigned Illumina schematic: the Rotem et al. (2015) droplet-based single-cell native-chromatin ChIP implementation, locally labelled Drop-ChIP and scChIP-seq. The retained route is cell suspension → loading with lysis buffer and MNase → fusion with unique-oligo droplets → pooling → ChIP → sequencing/barcoded sequences. The separate oligo-droplet input is a reagent branch, and the left single-cell/chromatin thumbnail identifies the assay rather than an additional preparation route. Primary full-text evidence resolves barcode attachment, emulsion release with carrier addition, and the broad library interface; those additions are distinguished from depicted captions. The upper scATAC-seq row, lower SMDB row and clipped right-hand chemical legend have no connecting route to this row and are outside scope. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete execution protocol or a claim about all single-cell ChIP-seq implementations.
